nodes.goal: Turn the frozen launch scope, chosen direction included, into the product contract
nodes.body:
## Attention Contract
- Primary outcome: the frozen scope restated as the contract every later node is held to
- Non-goals / out-of-scope: do not reopen the frozen scope or add a topic the user never confirmed.
- Must-read inputs: the frozen product baseline, the chosen direction and the confirmed acceptance.
- Optional inputs: none.
- Context budget: read the frozen scope and this node's own inputs, nothing else.
- Quality questions: does every confirmed intent, the direction included, reach a node that owes something for it?
- Stop conditions: stop when a required input is missing or unconfirmed.
- Repair targets: code_gaps, quality_gaps.

nodes.goal: Build the lesson and review content library and document its schema
nodes.body:
## Attention Contract
- Primary outcome: one language pair's lessons and review items, with the schema written down
- Non-goals / out-of-scope: do not author a second language pair before the first one retains learners.
- Must-read inputs: the product contract and the confirmed acceptance for review scheduling.
- Optional inputs: none.
- Context budget: read the frozen scope and this node's own inputs, nothing else.
- Quality questions: can a reader rebuild the library from the schema document alone?
- Stop conditions: stop when a required input is missing or unconfirmed.
- Repair targets: code_gaps, quality_gaps.

nodes.goal: Design the learner journeys the chosen direction implies and specify every screen they pass through
nodes.body:
## Attention Contract
- Primary outcome: the journeys of the steady-drip direction, and what each screen owes them
- Non-goals / out-of-scope: do not decide how a screen is built here; this node decides what it must do.
- Must-read inputs: the product contract, the chosen experience direction and its acceptance.
- Optional inputs: none.
- Context budget: read the frozen scope and this node's own inputs, nothing else.
- Quality questions: does every job a learner comes with reach a flow, and every flow a specified screen?
- Stop conditions: stop when a required input is missing or unconfirmed.
- Repair targets: code_gaps, quality_gaps.

nodes.goal: Review the designed journeys against the chosen direction before anything is built
nodes.body:
## Attention Contract
- Primary outcome: a fresh-context verdict on the designed journeys, with every must-fix named
- Non-goals / out-of-scope: do not read the designing node's reasoning or notes; judge the artifacts it shipped.
- Must-read inputs: the journey and screen specifications and the chosen direction they answer.
- Optional inputs: none.
- Context budget: read the listed design artifacts and the direction, nothing else.
- Quality questions: would a tired learner in four interrupted minutes get through this as designed?
- Stop conditions: stop when a required input is missing or unconfirmed.
- Repair targets: code_gaps, quality_gaps.

nodes.goal: Repair the design must-fix findings and re-run the design review
nodes.body:
## Attention Contract
- Primary outcome: every must-fix the design review recorded is answered in the specifications
- Non-goals / out-of-scope: do not close a finding by narrowing the direction that produced it.
- Must-read inputs: the design review report and the specifications it judged.
- Optional inputs: none.
- Context budget: read the frozen scope and this node's own inputs, nothing else.
- Quality questions: is each must-fix closed in the specification, or only argued with?
- Stop conditions: stop when a required input is missing or unconfirmed.
- Repair targets: code_gaps, quality_gaps.

nodes.goal: Implement the mobile/ screens of the steady-drip pass: home, session and progress, exactly as the screen requirements specify them
nodes.body:
## Attention Contract
- Primary outcome: every screen in the specification runs in mobile/ and resumes where it stopped
- Non-goals / out-of-scope: do not invent a screen the specification does not describe, or drop one it does.
- Must-read inputs: the screen requirements, the journey specification and the reviewed design.
- Optional inputs: none.
- Context budget: read the frozen scope and this node's own inputs, nothing else.
- Quality questions: does a screen do what the specification says it owes the journey, or what was easiest?
- Stop conditions: stop when a required input is missing or unconfirmed.
- Repair targets: code_gaps, quality_gaps.

nodes.goal: Verify the built product against the whole confirmed acceptance, direction included
nodes.body:
## Attention Contract
- Primary outcome: a run that proves each confirmed acceptance line on the built product
- Non-goals / out-of-scope: do not accept a criterion on a described behaviour instead of a run.
- Must-read inputs: the product contract and every implementation node's report.
- Optional inputs: none.
- Context budget: read the frozen scope and this node's own inputs, nothing else.
- Quality questions: is each acceptance line proved by an observed effect?
- Stop conditions: stop when a required input is missing or unconfirmed.
- Repair targets: code_gaps, quality_gaps.

nodes.goal: Run the react-native-ui automation suite (detox) over every learner flow on a device profile
nodes.body:
## Attention Contract
- Primary outcome: a detox run of each learner flow, interruption included, with its runner evidence kept
- Non-goals / out-of-scope: do not replace the automated run with documented manual scenarios.
- Must-read inputs: the journey specification and the mobile implementation report.
- Optional inputs: report BLOCKED_ENV when no simulator or device is available.
- Context budget: read the frozen scope and this node's own inputs, nothing else.
- Quality questions: does the react-native-ui-test-report cover every flow, or only the shortest pass?
- Stop conditions: stop when a required input is missing or unconfirmed.
- Repair targets: code_gaps, quality_gaps.

nodes.goal: Review the running product against the chosen direction, on the evidence it produced
nodes.body:
## Attention Contract
- Primary outcome: a fresh-context verdict on the product as it actually runs, with every must-fix named
- Non-goals / out-of-scope: do not read the building nodes' reasoning or notes; judge the recorded runs.
- Must-read inputs: the verification reports, the runner evidence and the chosen direction.
- Optional inputs: none.
- Context budget: read the listed run evidence and the direction, nothing else.
- Quality questions: does living with this product feel like the direction the user chose?
- Stop conditions: stop when a required input is missing or unconfirmed.
- Repair targets: code_gaps, quality_gaps.

nodes.goal: Repair the runtime must-fix findings and re-run the affected checks
nodes.body:
## Attention Contract

- Non-goals / out-of-scope: do not close a finding by narrowing the criterion that found it.
- Must-read inputs: the runtime review report and the verification runs it judged.
- Optional inputs: none.
- Context budget: read the frozen scope and this node's own inputs, nothing else.
- Quality questions: is each must-fix closed by a rerun rather than an argument?
- Stop conditions: stop when a required input is missing or unconfirmed.
- Repair targets: code_gaps, quality_gaps.

nodes.goal: Close the launch: every confirmed intent delivered, reviewed and repaired
nodes.body:
## Attention Contract
- Primary outcome: one verdict that the launch scope is delivered and its review findings are closed
- Non-goals / out-of-scope: do not close while a must-fix before release is still open.
- Must-read inputs: the runtime review report, the repair report and the verification runs.
- Optional inputs: none.
- Context budget: read the frozen scope and this node's own inputs, nothing else.
- Quality questions: is any must-fix before release still open on the artifact this node closes on?
- Stop conditions: stop when a required input is missing or unconfirmed.
- Repair targets: code_gaps, quality_gaps.
